content.name: Engineering Fundamentals 101 | On-Demand Webinar
content.linkedin_copy:
Discover the importance of the I-V characteristic curve, a graphical representation of current (I) and power as a function of voltage (V), widely used for characterizing electronic devices.

Join Keithley Application Engineer Liz Makley as she demystifies the I-V curve and its significance in understanding device behavior, performance, and reliability.

Watch this on-demand webinar to gain a solid foundation in basic characteristics and be equipped to tackle more complex tests in the future.

content.name: Multichannel, Mixed Domain Analysis
content.linkedin_copy:
If you are an engineer developing today's systems with multiple RF interfaces or complex embedded synthesizer or other RF functions, you will want to see how you can benefit from multi-channel, mixed domain signal acquisition and analysis to measure, and interpret signals across multiple channels, frequencies, and time intervals.

Discover how you can unlock exciting capabilities using hardware digital downconverters (DDCs) in parallel with time domain signal processing.

Watch our on-demand webinar, where Alan Wolke will showcase real-world demonstrations of the benefits of these measurements across different RF signals with their own distinct settings.

content.name: On-Demand Webinar: Beyond AI-Copy-Paste Engineering: Advanced AI-Integration Success in T&M Workflows
content.linkedin_copy:
Most engineers have experimented with AI by asking for code snippets and pasting them into their workflow. While this approach is useful, it barely scratches the surface of leading techniques for agentic code development. AI-assisted instrumentation is no longer speculative or distant — it's emerging rapidly and already usable today.
Hosted by Tech Briefs, this 45-minute technical on-demand webinar explores how engineers can move beyond copy-paste prompting toward context-driven, plan-first AI workflows that actively control instruments, analyze data, and generate results in real time.
 You'll learn how AI can:
Write automation code
Configure oscilloscopes and signal source
Execute measurements and perform math and plotting
Automatically export structured data
 Watch now to explore emerging AI‑assisted instrumentation.   https://app.webinar.net/Gp5d8bMWAxR
